final_status.message: Session 46 (events-v3-20261108_46_test_events_write_heavy) was rejected by the audit: row seq 270 had an incomplete process list (behavioral-inputs-v1). One live read held two torn spots of the tasks list: the hyptcn-lab@worker process (python3 190484) crashed under the zamok_tabulky lock and its postgres backend 190491 exited mid-list, and a new kernel thread (kworker/1:2 253787) was linked at the tail into the recycled task_struct of an exited orders thread whose page was read before its initialization. The rules prev (0b61ffd) and tail (b065ee4) each cover one of these shapes, not both, so the row was correctly refused. Owner decision 2026-11-13: close the campaign with its 45 accepted sessions (groups 1-7 complete, group 8 has sessions 43-45) and evaluate them as an explicitly incomplete allocation; no new campaign, and features/ and guestparse/ stay unchanged (a walk fix would change extractor_sha256). The combined shape is a documented limitation.
